crownHunt.pageDescription: Manage Crown Hunt points and review claims.
crownHunt.deleteConfirmBody: The crown is permanently removed and disappears from the map immediately. This cannot be undone. Collection history is kept.
crownHunt.deleteReasonPlaceholder: Why is the crown being removed?
crownHunt.safetyWarning: The point must not be placed on a roadway or another unsafe stopping location.
crownHunt.activateConfirmBody: Confirm that the location is safe for parking and that the app can be used without traffic danger.
crownHunt.safetyNotePlaceholder: Describe why the location is safe...
crownHunt.formCollectableHint: A Crown is a map collectable — pick a spot, pick a rarity, and confirm the location is safe. No text needed.
crownHunt.tierCustomNotice: This crown has a custom reward ({points} KP) that matches no tier. It is kept if you save. Pick a tier above to change it.
crownHunt.formCollectorsLabel: How many people can collect this crown?
crownHunt.collectorsEveryoneHint: Unlimited — any number of people can collect it until it ends. Best for events.
crownHunt.collectorsLimitedHint: Only the first set number of people can collect it, then the crown is done.
crownHunt.collectorsLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
crownHunt.autoSpawnFlagNotice: Auto-spawn is off (the crownHuntSpawn feature flag is disabled). Activating an area here spawns nothing until the flag is turned on — it is safe to prepare areas in advance.
crownHunt.errorAuth: You are not authorised (admin sign-in or App Check failed). Sign in again and retry.
crownHunt.areasIntro: Draw the areas (polygon, circle, or rectangle) the auto-spawn may place crowns inside. Crowns only spawn in an active, safety-confirmed area.
crownHunt.areaHint_polygon: Click to add each corner; double-click to close the polygon.
crownHunt.areaHint_rectangle: Click one corner, then the opposite corner.
crownHunt.areaHint_circle: Click to drop the centre, then set the radius below.
crownHunt.areaSafetyWarning: Activating lets crowns appear inside this area for real members to drive to and stop at. Only activate areas you have judged safe to stop and collect in.
crownHunt.areaSafeConfirm: I confirm this is a safe area for players to stop and collect.
crownHunt.areaNoAreas: No spawn areas yet. Draw one to get started.
crownHunt.areaActivateBody: Crowns will begin spawning inside this area once the auto-spawn feature flag is on. Confirm it is safe first.
crownHunt.areaDeleteBody: The area is removed and its live auto-spawned crowns are drained immediately. This cannot be undone.

areaError.polygon_too_few: A polygon needs at least 4 points (3 corners plus the closing point).
areaError.polygon_too_many: A polygon may have at most 500 points.
areaError.polygon_not_closed: The polygon ring must be closed (first and last point equal).
areaError.polygon_too_few_distinct: A polygon needs at least three distinct corners.
areaError.circle_radius_range: The radius must be between 10 and 50000 metres.
areaError.rectangle_lat_order: The rectangle's north edge must be above its south edge.
areaError.rectangle_lng_order: The rectangle's east edge must be right of its west edge (no antimeridian wrap).
areaError.vertex_out_of_range: A coordinate is outside the valid latitude/longitude range.
areaError.area_too_large: The area is too large (its bounding box exceeds 20000 grid cells). Draw several smaller areas.

crownHunt.diagEstimateNote: These times are estimates. The spawner runs every {minutes} min, visits active areas round-robin (least-recently-served first), shares a per-run cell budget across all areas, and skips cells already at target — so a given cell can only be bracketed, not pinned.
crownHunt.diagServiceLabel: Estimated next visit to this area
crownHunt.diagServiceInactive: This area is inactive, so it is not in the spawn queue.
crownHunt.diagQueueValue: {ahead} active area(s) ahead ({total} active in total)
crownHunt.diagReingestFailed: The OpenStreetMap (Overpass) lookup timed out or failed. The previously cached safe stops were kept. Please try again in a moment.
crownHunt.diagReingestError: Could not run POI ingestion. Please try again.
crownHunt.diagNoBlockers: No blockers — this area would receive crowns on its next visit.

diagBlocker.spawn_flag_off: The auto-spawn feature flag (crownHuntSpawn) is off — the whole engine is dormant.
diagBlocker.area_inactive: The area is not active, so the spawner never considers it.
diagBlocker.area_not_confirmed: The area is not safety-confirmed, so it stays inert even if activated.
diagBlocker.area_oversize: The area is too large; the spawner skips it entirely until it is redrawn smaller.
diagBlocker.no_area_pois: No cached safe-stop POIs. POI ingestion may not have run yet, or this region genuinely has none. Nothing anchors a crown, so nothing spawns.
diagBlocker.pois_stale: The cached POIs are older than the weekly refresh — they may be out of date.
diagBlocker.all_cells_below_activity_floor: Every scanned cell is below the activity floor (A < 1): no members have recently stopped here.
diagBlocker.all_cells_at_target: Every scanned active cell already holds its target number of live crowns.

crownHunt.diagCandidatesSummary: {candidates} of {scanned} scanned cells are spawn candidates ({total} cells span this area).
crownHunt.statsIntro: Kronjakt statistics from the season aggregates. The rarity breakdown and heat map cover auto-spawned crowns only; hand-placed crowns are shown as a separate remainder.
crownHunt.statRarityNote: Auto-spawned crowns only. Hand-placed crowns carry no rarity and appear as the remainder row.
crownHunt.statHeatNote: Each circle is a ~1.1 km grid cell, sized by crowns spawned and coloured by crowns collected.

partnerOffers.endReasonPlaceholder: Why is this offer being ended?

partnerOffers.formCurrencyCodeLabel: Currency code (e.g. SEK, required for fixed discount)
partnerOffers.codeNeverShownInList: ⚠️ Discount codes are never shown in lists or details — only via the Show code feature for active KCC members.

partnerInsights.pageDescription: Statistics are shown only in aggregate form.
partnerInsights.thresholdNote: At least 10 unique users are required for anonymous pass-by statistics.

driveHeat.pageDescription: An anonymised heatmap of where the community drives, aggregated into a hex grid. Use it to see the busiest areas for in-app digital billboard placements.
driveHeat.privacyNote: Aggregate only. Companies never see identity, live location or drive history. A hex appears only if at least 10 distinct drivers drove there, and every drive's start and end (home/work) is trimmed off before aggregation.
driveHeat.meta: Rolling {windowDays} days. Last updated: {generatedAt}. {cells} hexes shown.
driveHeat.legendNote: Colour shows how much an area is driven relative to the busiest one — not absolute counts.
driveHeat.sparse: No heatmap yet. It stays sparse until drive volume clears the floor of at least 10 unique drivers per hex.

billboards.safetyCheck1: The placement is not the partner's ordinary location marker on the map.
billboards.safetyCheck2: The placement is not on an active road lane.
billboards.safetyCheck3: The content does not imitate a road sign.
billboards.safetyCheck4: The placement does not obstruct important map information.
billboards.safetyCheck5: The content is clearly marked as advertising.
billboards.safetyCheck6: The placement is suitable for the map experience.
